findings.mechanism: Queries issued inside a loop cause N+1 pattern; each shipment triggers a separate DB call via name_for, scaling queries with result set.
findings.remediation: Replace per‑shipment name_for call with a single query that joins Shipment and Courier (or batch load) to fetch courier names in one statement.
findings.arithmetic: queries = 1 (initial select) + N (name_for per shipment); for 40 shipments => 1+40=41 queries per request.
